name: Parsh
tagline: The system of record for multi-campus ministries
positioning: Parsh unifies membership, giving, and volunteer operations for large church networks — so every campus runs on one accountable source of truth.

hero.h1: Run every campus on one source of truth
hero.sub: Parsh consolidates membership records, giving reconciliation, and volunteer clearances across every location — replacing the spreadsheets your finance and pastoral teams quietly maintain in parallel.

features.title: Giving reconciliation, closed weekly
features.description: Match online, text, and plate gifts to the right fund and household automatically, then export a bank-ready statement your finance team can sign off on every Monday.

features.title: One directory, every campus
features.description: Merge duplicate profiles across locations and keep household relationships intact when a family moves from the north campus to the south.

features.title: Volunteer clearances that hold up
features.description: Track background checks, training, and expirations for children's ministry, and block scheduling for anyone whose clearance has lapsed.

features.title: Contribution statements at scale
features.description: Generate IRS-ready year-end statements for 40,000 households in one run, with per-campus branding and mailed or digital delivery.

features.title: Service and room scheduling
features.description: Coordinate worship teams, rooms, and equipment across concurrent services without the double-booked keyboard on Sunday morning.

features.title: Audit-ready role permissions
features.description: Give campus admins exactly what they need and log every change, so your board and auditors can trace who touched which record.

testimonials.quote: Before Parsh, closing the books meant reconciling four giving platforms by hand every month. Now it's a Monday-morning export and our controller trusts the number.
testimonials.name: Danielle Ortega

testimonials.quote: We onboarded nine campuses onto one directory and finally stopped mailing duplicate contribution statements to the same family.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The volunteer clearance blocks alone justified the switch. No unvetted adult can get scheduled in kids' ministry, and I can prove it to our insurer.
testimonials.name: Rev. Angela Boone

pricing.blurb: For single-campus churches formalizing their records.
For multi-campus churches running shared operations.
For denominations and church networks at national scale.
